% de adultos (15+) con una cuenta en una: % of adults (15+) with an account at a financial institution or mobile money provider.
% de adultos que tomó prestado de un ban: % of adults who borrowed from a bank or another formal financial institution (indicator fin22a; excludes mobile money).
% de adultos que hizo o recibió un pago: % of adults who made or received a digital payment in the past year.
Diferencia en puntos porcentuales en ten: Percentage-point difference in account ownership between men and women (lower is better). The absolute value is used.
% de adultos que hizo un pago digital a: % of adults who made a digital payment to a merchant in the past year. Unlike 'made or received a digital payment', it requires trusting the merchant, the rail and reversibility.
Transacciones anuales en el riel naciona: Annual transactions on the national instant payment rail divided by the adult population (15+). Observatory arithmetic on each central bank's official figures: same perimeter (the instant rail only) so the comparison is valid.
Índice del Observatorio (0–100) que pond: Observatory index (0–100) weighting the age, adoption and interoperability of the national instant payment rail.
Dimensionar cuánto efectivo queda por di: Size how much cash in retail is still left to digitize.
% de adultos que NO usó tarjeta ni celul: % of adults who used NEITHER a card NOR a phone for any in-store purchase in the past year. Lower is better: it measures how many people remain entirely outside digital payment at the point of sale.
Índice del Observatorio (0–100): en qué: Observatory index (0–100): how far the domestic rail crosses the border. It combines the existence of an international link, the cost of remittances into the country and the framework for stablecoins as a de facto rail.
Número de fintechs locales activas (comp: Number of active local fintechs (local component, foreign firms excluded).
Inversión de capital de riesgo (equity): Venture capital (equity) raised in 2025, in US$ millions across all sectors, with a homogeneous methodology for the six countries. Fintech took 61% of regional capital.
Basel AML Index: puntaje de riesgo de la: Basel AML Index: money-laundering risk score from 0 (low) to 10 (high). Lower is better.
De cada 100 adultos que recibieron una l: Out of every 100 adults who received a call or text asking for money, how many sent it. Direct arithmetic on two Findex series (con22 ÷ con21): it separates vulnerability from exposure, because almost everyone receives the attempt.
Posición en el Chainalysis Global Crypto: Position in the Chainalysis Global Crypto Adoption Index (1 = highest adoption worldwide). Lower is better.
Índice del Observatorio (0–100) según el: Observatory index (0–100) based on how developed the legal framework for virtual asset providers and tokenization is.
Índice del Observatorio (0–100) según la: Observatory index (0–100) based on the maturity of the Open Finance framework: from mandatory and operational to non-existent.
Índice del Observatorio (0–100) que comb: Observatory index (0–100) combining a dedicated fintech law, an active regulatory sandbox and a personal data protection law.
